blocks.text: Where Is Kudlu Gate? Understanding the Micro-Location

Kudlu Gate is a key junction on Hosur Main Road (NH 48), positioned between Bommanahalli to the north and Electronic City to the south. It sits within BBMP limits with full civic infrastructure — piped water, power supply, solid waste management, and road maintenance — while offering lower residential density than inner-city areas like Koramangala or HSR Layout.
Heart of Harmony: Distance from Key Landmarks
Heart of Harmony’s 5–6 km distance from Silk Board makes it one of the closest luxury residential options for buyers seeking luxury 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments near Silk Board in South Bengaluru.
